notes: Sheet is north-up. Top half is Eden Park. PARKSIDE (E. COURT) PL. (50') runs along the park from the left edge, bends ENE and ends at MARTIN. The park road printed DRIVE (40') comes from the top edge SSE, crosses Parkside and runs on (40' printed) to merge into Martin just north of Paradrome; named 'Drive' as printed. MORRILL (50') runs from Parkside south across PARADROME to HATCH, south of which the same line is CARNEY (40') to the bottom edge (same name change as sheet 129). Morrill's drawn width near Parkside is ~50 ft between x~287 and ~458, centre on the 6 in. pipe. PARADROME (width not printed) runs from the left edge to Martin. HATCH (40') runs from the left edge past FORT VIEW PL. (PAVILION) (40') to a dead end at the Martin lots. Fort View Place runs from Hatch south and turns SW at y~3985 into the 40 ft diagonal that leaves the bottom-left corner; that diagonal is the leg sheet 129 prints PAVILION, so it is named Pavilion Street here, and the turn is recorded as a Fort View Place / Pavilion Street junction. The Carney / diagonal junction is just below the bottom edge (not recorded). WOOD STEPS run ESE from the Fort View corner down toward sheet 110 (not a street). MARTIN (50', many water mains and a railway track in the street) runs from the top edge to the bottom edge. E. 3RD (50') runs NNE along the right side from the bottom edge to the top-right corner, parallel to Martin; Martin and E 3rd do not meet on this sheet. WHITAKER (no width printed) runs ESE from E 3rd to the right. COLLARD (60') comes from the top edge SSE and turns ESE to meet E 3rd at the paper edge. ASH is printed at the top edge between Martin and Collard but its centreline is off the sheet (not recorded). A double water pipe runs ESE between the Collard lots and the 9th St. Baptist Church lots to E 3rd near lot 1280; it crosses lots and is not recorded as a street. Pipes running diagonally across the lots east of Martin are ignored. Scale ~3.4 px/ft (checked on the scale bar).
